title: Petra and the Thorn
author: Astrid Brightwater
blurb: Bram Crane, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
